_source: Arkia OM-A 10.12 — Fuel Planning and Compliance Guidelines

contingency.basisA2Requires: En-route alternate within a circle centred on the planned route, at a distance from destination not exceeding the greater of 25% of total flight plan distance, or 20% + 50 NM; circle radius = 20% of total flight plan distance (still air).
contingency.basisB: Fuel to fly 5 minutes at holding speed at 1,500 ft above the destination airport in standard conditions.

finalReserve: 30 minutes holding at 1500 ft above the alternate (or destination if no alternate required), standard conditions
noAlternateHold: 15 minutes at 1500 ft above the destination, standard conditions
isolatedAirport: 2 hours at cruise speed above the destination
